response.justification: Bogdan possesses valuable geospatial expertise through GISCollective and Green Map projects—a rare skillset directly relevant to routing data pipelines. His experience building high-performance distributed systems at Dunnhumby and strong software craftsmanship are positive indicators. However, his C++ skills are significantly outdated (last professional C++ work was 11 years ago at National Instruments), and his recent 3+ years have focused on TypeScript/Node.js web development. He lacks direct routing/navigation guidance system experience and any Rust background. While capable of learning, a mid-senior IC role typically requires immediate productivity in the primary language.
strengths: Deep geospatial and GIS domain expertise through GISCollective founder role and Green Map mapping projects—rare, directly applicable to routing data pipelines
Proven ability to build high-performance distributed systems; worked with micro-services handling millions of requests/second and real-time data processing at Dunnhumby
Strong engineering mindset: demonstrates TDD, CI/CD mastery, and created testing frameworks (Fluent-Asserts, Trial), indicating rigor compatible with mission-critical systems
concerns: C++ expertise is severely outdated; last professional C++ work ended 11 years ago; recent 3+ years heavily focused on TypeScript/Node.js web development
No direct experience with routing algorithms, navigation guidance systems, or specialized data pipeline architecture; GIS background is mapping-focused, not routing-focused
Career trajectory has moved progressively away from systems programming toward full-stack web development, raising questions about deep systems-level competency maintenance

key_factors.factor: Stale C++ and lack of Rust experience
Geospatial domain expertise and GIS background
Distributed systems and backend infrastructure experience
